psf_cap_vs_market_gap.implied_psf_cap: For >=1,000 sqft in the $2.0-2.2M band the effective PSF ceiling is ~$2,000-2,200 psf at 1,000 sqft, tightening to ~$1,818-2,000 psf at 1,100 sqft and ~$1,540-1,700 psf at 1,300 sqft
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.above_cap: Newest freehold (post-2020) is structurally above the cap: The Lilium ~$2,321, The Gazania ~$2,618, Kovan Jewel ~$2,140, The Line @ Tanjong Rhu ~$2,346, Bliss @ Kovan 3BR asks ~$2,408. Gap of ~$200-400 psf over the ceiling.
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.at_or_below_cap: Seasoned freehold (2012-2020) in non-prime D19/D14 sits at or under the cap: The Quinn $1,940, Carpmael $2,044, Oasis Garden $1,673, Vacanza $1,632, Paya Lebar Residences $1,831, Fiorenza $1,504. Every pass and lead clusters here.
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.takeaway: The buyer's budget clears the market only for 2012-2020 vintage freehold in non-prime pockets. Anything newer or more central sits $200-400 psf above the cap.

filter_tradeoffs.units_vs_psf_vs_region: The two passes come from mid/boutique projects (The Quinn 139u, Carpmael 16u). The large developments (Vacanza 473u, Flamingo 393u) hold the ideal-size 3BR stacks and the best liquidity, but their in-band economics don't line up - Vacanza's 1,012-1,141 sqft stack trades BELOW the floor, Flamingo's smallest 3BR is above the ceiling. D19 non-prime freehold gives the lowest PSF (The Quinn $1,940, Oasis $1,673) at the cost of location; D15 East Coast freehold commands $2,044-2,346 psf for the MRT/liveability premium; D14 sits in between but good 3BR sizes push total price to/over the ceiling.
filter_tradeoffs.new_implication: The binding constraint has flipped since June. In June the story was 'freehold >=1,000 sqft in-band is rare, full stop.' With the wider tracked universe it's now sharper: the $2.0M FLOOR is doing as much filtering as the $2.2M ceiling. Vacanza's ideal-size stack is excluded for being too cheap; Paya Lebar Residences and Elliot overshoot on total price because their 3BR are 1,260-1,313 sqft. The sweet spot is a ~1,050-1,150 sqft 3BR (small enough to stay under $2.2M, large enough to clear 1,000 sqft) in 2012-2020 freehold - exactly the two passes. Widening the size floor toward ~1,000-1,080 sqft, or flexing the price floor down ~$300k to reach Vacanza's value stack, would each roughly double the qualifying set.
